Overview.Name: Priyanka Tribhuwan
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) sauted with veggies
Option 2: Two - Three whole egg omelette + any 1 fruit
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Plain oats (1 cup ~150 g) & Protein Shake (1 scoop)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_4: Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & 2 eggs (Fried Rice)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (100 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with paneer or eggs before eating rice to control portions.
For boredom cravings, drink water or have a small dark chocolate first and wait 10 minutes.
Keep meals simple and consistent to support gym recovery.
Get sunlight exposure in the morning which will improve your sleep and improving sleep will significantly improve energy and control cravings.
